newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies six muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies six muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said Tuesday it qualified for bond insurance the following six municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Temple Terrace, Fla., $3.13 million water and sewer revenue bonds.
--Grant County, Ind., $4.85 million general obligation bonds.
--Boone, N.C., $1.325 million GO and refunding bonds.
--Cobleskill-Rich Central School District, N.Y., $4.7 million GOs.
--New York State Bridge Authority, $49.22 million revenue bonds.
--North Colonie Central School District, N.Y., $2.223 million school bonds.
